purpose: Teach: みなす/逃れる/しようが/見なさ/傾き/負い/懲り/劣る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様をお店の宝とみなすようにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we treat our customers like they're the treasure of this shop.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Soft opening. Gentle conviction—not lecturing, but inviting Aoi into a shared value. Slight lift at the end of the thought, like an embrace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期から逃れる方法はないから乗り切ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there's no escaping the busy season, so let's just push through it together.
lines.style: Practical reassurance. Steady, grounded delivery. A knowing acknowledgment of difficulty without drama. Companionable—we're in this together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しい日は「しようがない」と割り切ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, on hectic days, let's accept that things just can't always be perfect.
lines.style: Gentle permission-giving. Slightly lower register. The release of tension in the voice—letting go of what can't be controlled. Warm without being soft.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人スタッフを甘く見なされないように指導しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we guide the new staff carefully—don't underestimate them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, attentive. A light emphasis on responsibility without weight. The care of someone who remembers what it felt like to be new.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、看板の傾きを直して綺麗にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's straighten that crooked sign and keep things looking sharp.
lines.style: Bright, practical encouragement. Quick tempo. A small smile in the voice—pride in taking care of what matters. Energizing rather than tasking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の期待を負いつつ頑張ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep meeting our customers' expectations and give it our best effort.
lines.style: Affirming and steady. Quiet pride underlying the words. A gentle reminder that they're capable of this. Not burden—purpose.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ミスに懲りずに前向きにいこうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't let mistakes discourage you—let's keep moving forward with hope.
lines.style: Soft but firm. Compassionate redirect. A slight pause before the hopeful part, like she's drawing Aoi back toward possibility. Tender underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、他店に劣ると思わずに自信を持とうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't compare us to other shops—believe in what we do here.
lines.style: Grounded conviction. Warm but clear-eyed. A light emphasis on 'us' and 'here'—invoking pride in their shared space. Close and intimate tone.
